text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Would you permit me to escort you this 
evening? I have arrived to pick you up, my 
'Empress.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...What are you scheming? Where are you 
planning to take me?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course, right into the dazzling world 
of ramen♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry, I made sure to find a 
place that fits Air Groove-san's tastes 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to accept it as a wonderful 
memory. ...What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"'—Rejoice, for I grant you permission to 
escort me. Pick me up at 18:00. Do not be 
late!'"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, once we're back, you're cleaning 
your room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
An absurd amount of stuff arrived this 
year too... From your parents, addressed 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ahaha~. Sorry about that, okay?
